study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter, prospective observational study
cohort: Women with a history of previous cesarean delivery who required emergent cesarean delivery
finding: Among women who underwent emergent repeat cesarean delivery, surgical speed was associated with an increased risk for maternal complications.
mod_finding: This study investigated maternal outcomes in women with a history of cesarean delivery who required emergent repeat cesarean delivery, finding that faster surgical speed was associated with an increased risk for maternal complications.
